correctness.rationale: The complete-absorption argument uses positivity, invariant-set compactness, and leaf dephasing to exclude any nonzero loss-free asymptotic state. The five-variable equation is reconstructed directly from the specified trace-decreasing Lindblad generator; its integrated identities yield the exact unconditional mean for every permitted leaf count, real coherent coupling and energy, and strictly positive dissipative rate. Explicit derivatives prove strict convexity and both rate optima. The packaged verifier independently constructs the full complex Liouvillian and checks 40 leaf-specific cases with maximum 7.11e-14 absolute error and 8 optimization checks. Finite cases are corroboration, not the general proof.

value.rationale: A symmetric lossy star is a natural model of excitation trapping, yet coherent dark states persist at zero noise and strong dephasing produces Zeno slowing. A single exact expression resolves this transport tradeoff for every leaf count, independent hub and leaf hopping, sink rate, onsite detuning and positive selective dephasing. The unique noise optimum and exact quadratic interleaf detuning penalty identify a concrete tunable design boundary rather than an arbitrary parameter calculation. The result gives a complete infinite-family mean-time law and a singular zero-noise transition, without claiming a paper-sized general transport theorem.
